boundaryRules.gospel: Biblical reading body from first verse through source endpoint; exclude headings, introduction, responses and following litany.
boundaryRules.absolution: All prose beneath the relevant absolution heading through its final Amen; stop before the next heading or instruction.
boundaryRules.textIntegrity: Preserve source spelling and wording; do not generate or harmonize prayer text.
boundaryRules.editionReview: Require an explicit review against the selected edition; structural validation does not prove authenticity.

offices.title: Third Hour
offices.boundaryNote: Primary heading labels John 14:26-15:3; actual reading includes opening clause of 15:4. Agpeya.org labels through 15:4 but likewise includes only its first clause. Preserve actual source endpoint rather than extending to the full verse.

offices.title: Midnight
offices.boundaryNote: Three watch Gospels followed by one common lay absolution. The further Luke 2:29-32 reading and priestly absolution have separate liturgical rubrics and are excluded from this default personal profile.

sample.title: Microphone check — not an Agpeya prayer
sample.text: This is a microphone check. I am reading each sentence aloud at a comfortable pace. The garden path turns beside a quiet fountain. I can pause, breathe, and continue from the words on the screen.
sample.source: Original nonreligious test passage authored for this project
